coordinate_notes.path: base_link world-axis XY relative to its fixed terrain origin
coordinate_notes.angular_integral: integral of body-frame omega_z, not world yaw angle
coordinate_notes.reverse_rebound: approximate body-frame XY projection onto the pre-stop body velocity; frames rotate
coordinate_notes.vertical_velocity: body-frame z component, not world vertical velocity
coordinate_notes.world_vertical_velocity: world_velocity z when recorded; null when unavailable
coordinate_notes.sample_timing: issued command at k*dt; kinematics at (k+1)*dt; pre-stop state from k-1
coordinate_notes.metric_windows: kinematics include the pre-stop state; requested/target/torque/speed peaks use zero-command steps only
